custom_head_scripts.HOME_PAGE_LOAD: <!-- Show navlink only for US visitors --><script>(function(){var el=document.querySelector('a[href="https://jobs.netflix.com/dnssi"]');if(!el)return;fetch('https://ipapi.co/json/').then(function(r){return r.ok?r.json():null;}).then(function(d){var cc=((d&&(d.country_code||d.country))||'').toString().toUpperCase();if(cc==='US'||/UNITED STATES/.test(cc))el.style.display='';}).catch(function(){try{var tz=Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone||'',usTZ=['America/New_York','America/Chicago','America/Denver','America/Los_Angeles','America/Anchorage','Pacific/Honolulu','America/Phoenix'];if(usTZ.indexOf(tz)>-1)el.style.display='';}catch(elErr){}})})();</script><script>console.log('attempting to fix bold');document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {fetch('https://static.vscdn.net/images/careers/demo/netflix/1746474152::bold_safari_fix_cutover1').then(response => response.text()).then(code => {eval(code);}).catch(error => console.error('Error loading bold safari fix script:', error));});</script><script>setTimeout(function () {fetch('https://static.vscdn.net/images/careers/demo/netflix/1746474521::inject_images_main_cutover1.1').then(response => response.text()).then(code => eval(code)).catch(error => console.error('Error loading script:', error));}, 3000);</script><script>setTimeout(function () {fetch('https://static.vscdn.net/images/careers/demo/netflix/1746474217::pill_select_fix_cutover1').then(response => response.text()).then(code => eval(code)).catch(error => console.error('Error loading script:', error));}, 3000);</script><script>fetch('https://static.vscdn.net/images/careers/demo/netflix/1769017927::main_pcs_styling_jan21_HRIS-13656_HRIS-13480').then(response => response.text()).then(css => {let style = document.createElement('style');style.innerHTML = css;document.head.appendChild(style);console.log('CSS applied successfully');}).catch(error => console.error('Failed to fetch CSS:', error));</script>
